[[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]]: "Your thoughts betray you, Father. I feel the good in you... the conflict."

[[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]]: "There is no conflict."

Gotta love cards that you can play during a game as if you were quoting

Like in the movie, you will also get to respond to the Light Side's "[[I Feel The Conflict]]" and take back a card to prevent [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] from becoming Anakin again.

Players will compare this to the Light Side counterpart [[Our Only Hope]] (from the DSII set) but there is a subtle difference. Note that the Lost part of this card has no special restrictions like [[Our Only Hope]]. This means that you can send [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] into battle even against [[Luke Skywalker{{!}}Luke]] &#150; as long as your opponent isn't playing [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him{{!}}There Is Good In Him]] (TIGIH) &#150; and still keep [[Darth Vader{{!}}Vader]] alive
